evidence: Changes net_processing.cpp and P2P message handling to reject malformed blocks and transactions as deserialization errors rather than passing them to validation and disconnecting peers.
rationale: Prevents network-message DoS attacks that exploit full message deserialization before validation. As the author notes, an attacker can fit ~400,000 zero-input/zero-output transactions into a 4 MB block message to force individual CTransaction allocations, or send up to 16M weight in non-witness transactions; early deserialization checks abort these payloads immediately.
